declarations.description:

declarations.description:
Wires a field's label, help, error and count to its control (aria-describedby, aria-invalid, live messages), so
nothing has to be wired by hand.
declarations.name: PixelField

attributes.description: What screen readers hear once typing pauses in a field with a count; {left} is filled in.
attributes.name: count-text

attributes.description: "group" describes the whole group (a set of checkboxes or radios), not its first control.
attributes.name: role

attributes.description: The label beside the control (--pp-field-label-width, 64 pixels by default).
attributes.name: data-layout

declarations.summary: A form field that wires its words to its control.

declarations.description:
A tray to drop files on, or click to browse. The files live in the native <input type="file"> inside, so they go
with the form; each picked file gets a row with a remove button.
declarations.name: PixelFileDrop

members.name: files
members.description: The picked files, in order.

events.description: The list changed: files picked, dropped or removed.
events.name: pp-change

events.description: Dropped files that do not match the input's accept.
events.name: pp-reject

attributes.description: Put before each file name on its remove button.
attributes.name: remove-label

declarations.summary: Drop files, or click to browse.

declarations.description:
A WAI-ARIA menu button: a button and a [role=menu] popover list, with focus management, arrow keys, typeahead,
checkbox and radio items, and nested submenus.
declarations.name: PixelMenu

members.name: trigger
members.description: The button: the first button (or [aria-haspopup]) child.

members.name: menu
members.description: The list: the [role=menu] child.

members.name: items
members.description: This menu's items (not those of its submenus).

members.name: show
members.description: Opens the menu and focuses its first item (or its last).

members.name: close
members.description: Closes the menu and gives focus back to its button.

events.description: Before an item runs. Cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the menu open and the item unchanged.
events.name: pp-select

attributes.description: Lines the menu up with the end of its button instead of the start.
attributes.name: data-align

declarations.summary: A menu button and its list of actions.

declarations.description:
A number field with a pixel minus and plus. The <input type="number"> inside stays the real control; the buttons
are for pointers and touch, and step faster while held.
declarations.name: PixelNumber

events.description: The value was committed (the input's change).
events.name: pp-change

attributes.description: The minus button's accessible name.
attributes.name: decrease-label

attributes.description: The plus button's accessible name.
attributes.name: increase-label

declarations.summary: A number field with step buttons.

declarations.name: PixelRating

cssProperties.description: The score drawn (set by the element).
cssProperties.name: --pp-rating-value

cssProperties.description: How many stars are drawn (set by the element).
cssProperties.name: --pp-rating-max

events.description: A star was set by click or key (after input and change).
events.name: pp-change

attributes.name: value

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: How many stars.

attributes.name: readonly

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Switched off (also follows a disabled fieldset).

attributes.name: required

The form field name.

attributes.description: The message while required and not rated.

members.name: selectedRows

type.text: CustomEvent<{ column: number; direction: SortDirection; header: HTMLTableCellElement }>

declarations.description:
WAI-ARIA tabs over the tabs markup: ids and ARIA wired, one tab in the tab order, the arrow keys, Home and End,
the selected panel shown, and stepped scroll buttons for a row that overflows.

members.name: list
members.description: The tab list: the first [role=tablist] child.

members.name: tabs
members.description: The tabs, in order.

members.name: selected

events.description: After the person selects a tab.
events.name: pp-change

attributes.name: selected
attributes.description: The selected tab's index. Setting it selects that tab (no pp-change).
Select on focus, or only on Enter, Space and click.
attributes.name: activation

attributes.description: The tabs' tier; each tab gets the matching box variant.
attributes.name: data-variant

attributes.description: Smaller tabs: 16 pixels high instead of 20.
attributes.name: data-size

declarations.summary: Tabs: one panel at a time.

declarations.description:
A grid of tiles as one Tab stop: the arrow keys move in two dimensions, Home and End jump to the ends, disabled
tiles are skipped. Optionally it keeps the selection.
declarations.name: PixelTileGrid

members.name: selection
members.description: "single" or "follow"; anything else leaves selection to you.

members.name: tiles
members.description: The tiles that take focus, in order.

members.name: select
members.description: Selects a tile (aria-pressed in "single", aria-current in "follow"). Returns false if refused.

events.description: Before the selection moves. Cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the old one.

attributes.description: "single": pressing a tile selects it (aria-pressed); "follow": the focused tile is the current one (aria-current). Left out, selection is yours.
attributes.name: selection

declarations.summary: A grid of tiles moved through with the arrow keys.

declarations.description:

attributes.description: Where the toasts come up.
attributes.name: data-placement

attributes.description: Each toast's close button's accessible name.

attributes.description: The region's name.
attributes.name: aria-label

declarations.name: toast
declarations.description: Shows a toast in the page's toaster, adding one to <body> if there is none.
